Tokens, motion, ui, and the runifly, nostr, and exosquare themes are 0.3.0. patterns stays a 0.0.0 stub. This notes everything since 0.1.0.

Buttons, fields, and other controls use the display face. Body type classes still set the size, and prose keeps the body face. Toasts are a raised surface with padding, a border, and a lifted shadow, set in the display face.

Disabled buttons use a neutral fill and muted text on every theme. `--color-disabled-bg` follows the neutral status wash, and `--color-disabled-fg` follows muted text. Those aliases are declared again on `[data-theme]` and `[data-scheme]`. A disabled button has a quiet border, no shadow, and no hover or press change. A pending button keeps its own fill and text colour, shows a spinner, and does not run its action.

`RadioGroup` and `Switch` are new. Both take a label. A radio can take a description. The radio is fully round. The switch keeps the control radius. The switch thumb is instant under reduced motion.

`ConfirmSheet` takes its distance, duration, and ease from the active theme. Enter uses the sheet role. Exit uses the exit role. The backdrop uses the surface role on the way in and the exit role on the way out.

Nostr motion adds move and sheet roles. Feedback uses the hover ease. The exit is a 160ms strong ease-out. `@macro88/motion` adds `ease.out` for that curve. `ease.exit` is unchanged. Shared motion also adds role timings for surface, sheet, and exit. A theme may override them.

These packages are not on npm. Install the tarballs attached below by URL, and add a pnpm override for every @macro88 package so pnpm doesn't look for them on npm. INSTALL.md has the full setup. Checksums for every tarball are in SHA256SUMS.

## Migration

The nostr confirm sheet used to enter with `spring.lively`. It now enters with a 280ms tween on the drawer ease.

If app prose used `type-body-lg`, `type-body-md`, or `type-body-sm` to get the body face, add `font-body` to it.
